piggy.quality.title: Piggy — Helpers
piggy.quality.independent: These settings work independently of bhop.
piggy.quality.simple_debug.tip: Color groups for FPS, position, facing, biome, dimension coordinates, ping and server-measured TPS.
piggy.quality.shulker_preview.tip: Hover a shulker in your inventory to see its 27-slot contents.
piggy.quality.food_info.tip: Saturation and food previews inside vanilla hunger/hearts; no separate food panel.
piggy.quality.arrow_counter.tip: While holding a bow/crossbow, show ammo icons in usage order; adjacent identical arrow groups are combined.
piggy.quality.rocket_counter.tip: Only while gliding with an elytra, show firework totals for flight durations 1, 2 and 3.
piggy.quality.auto_restock.tip: Replace broken tools with the same type, depleted blocks, and used totems in the appropriate hand. Requires Piggy on the server.
piggy.quality.placement_assist.tip: Hold right-click on a ghost to bridge at up to one block every two ticks. Until release, only matching ghost cells can be placed.
piggy.quality.paired_doors.tip: Open/close matching adjacent wooden double doors together. Iron and powered doors are preserved. Requires Piggy on the server.
piggy.number.tip: Type a value (e.g. 5.5 or 5,5). Allowed range: %s – %s. Red values cannot be saved.
piggy.status.offline: Bhop also works without a server mod.
piggy.status.server: Using the ranges allowed by this server.
piggy.status.unsupported: Bhop is disabled by this server.
piggy.option.enabled.tip: Saved on/off preference, disabled by default. No activation combo. Crouching, damage and death do not turn this setting off. Timed jumps preserve speed.
piggy.option.autojump.tip: Hold jump to jump again on landing. When disabled, press jump separately for each hop.
piggy.option.air_accel.tip: Acceleration from strafing and turning in the air.
piggy.option.ground_accel.tip: Acceleration toward the requested direction while bhop is active on the ground.
piggy.option.ground_friction.tip: Ground slowdown without movement keys. Ice still reduces friction.
piggy.option.air_friction.tip: Air slowdown only when no movement keys are held.
piggy.option.speed_cap.tip: Maximum speed gained through bhop acceleration. External impulses are preserved separately.
piggy.option.show_hud.tip: Show horizontal speed in blocks per second. Green indicates a well-timed jump chain.
piggy.option.hud_x.tip: 0 is the left edge, 100 the right edge. Position scales with the screen.
piggy.option.hud_y.tip: 0 is the top edge, 100 the bottom edge. A sample HUD appears on this tab.
piggy.status.client_only: Client mode; server controls fall damage.
piggy.quality.anti_afk.tip: Randomly crouch (25%), jump (25%), or use a random movement key (50%). Holds: 100-300 ms; pauses: 500-2000 ms. Movement/sneak/jump keys cancel; mouse and clicks do not. Menus pause it.
piggy.menu.interface.tip: Speed HUD, F3, shulker preview, food and counters.
piggy.menu.interactive.tip: Quick restock, bridge assist and double doors.
piggy.menu.free_camera.tip: Detach the camera. Default shortcut: F4.
piggy.quality.anti_afk_jump.tip: When disabled, its 25% chance becomes WASD movement.
piggy.quality.anti_afk_crouch.tip: When disabled, its 25% chance becomes WASD movement.
piggy.option.free_camera.tip: F4 toggles the camera. WASD moves, jump rises, sneak descends, sprint moves faster. Block interactions are disabled.
piggy.option.free_camera_speed.tip: Camera movement speed in blocks per second.
piggy.quality.see_through_players.tip: Show other visible players with their skins and equipment through blocks. Off by default.
piggy.quality.bucket_cycle.tip: After filling or emptying a bucket, select the next hotbar bucket of the original type. Does not move inventory items. Stops until use is released when no matching hotbar buckets remain.
